video_title: IN OUR ATHLETE ERA: WITH MICHAEL PORTER JR.

quotes.speaker: Michael Porter Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Michael Porter Jr. on managing contract negotiations while doing podcasts
quotes.excerpt: I'm in contract negotiations, I was trying to stay away from the podcast world.

text_blocks.speaker: Michael Porter Jr.
text_blocks.text: Especially during this time, I'm in contract negotiations. I was trying to stay away from the podcast world, but I thought this one would be unique because most of the stuff I do is with other guys. Obviously, you guys are going to have your opinion as women, so it's going to be fun.

text_blocks.speaker: Isabel
text_blocks.text: We're very excited to have some fun questions for you.

quotes.speaker: Michael Porter Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Michael Porter Jr. on the transition from homeschooling to public school
quotes.excerpt: When I went from being homeschooled to public school in eighth grade, I definitely was a little weirdo.

text_blocks.speaker: Michael Porter Jr.
text_blocks.text: When I went from being homeschooled to public school in eighth grade, I definitely was a little weirdo. Not in the normal sense of high school weirdo, because we always played sports and the other thing my parents did, they bought a snow cone machine and made us work it so that we could have social interactions and we weren't weird and awkward. But in eighth grade, I definitely was shy.

text_blocks.speaker: Isabel
text_blocks.text: That's really smart of them to do that to get you guys out and socialize.

text_blocks.speaker: Michael Porter Jr.
text_blocks.text: Talking and learning how to do that, because most NBA players have never worked a real job, a nine-to-five type job. We were clocking in six-hour shifts, taking people's orders, it was the whole thing.

quotes.speaker: Michael Porter Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Michael Porter Jr. on the prevalence of cheating among professional athletes
quotes.excerpt: I think that's not just athletes or rappers, I think it's all people that have an abundance of options.

text_blocks.speaker: Isabel
text_blocks.text: One of them being that you guys are famously known for cheating. Would you say that's accurate?

text_blocks.speaker: Michael Porter Jr.
text_blocks.text: I don't want to put my fellow comrades on the bus, but yes. I think that's not just athletes or rappers, I think it's all people that have an abundance of options, an abundance of money, and an abundance of fame or power. Dudes in general, it's been like that since the beginning of time. If you were a king, you had a lot of wives and a lot of concubines. So I think it's just men who have a lot of options. It takes a lot of self-control to be able to be like, okay, I'm going to stick to one.

quotes.speaker: Michael Porter Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Michael Porter Jr. on his timeline for retiring from the NBA
quotes.excerpt: I don't want to play basketball for 10 more years. I want to be done in the next five, six years.

text_blocks.speaker: Michael Porter Jr.
text_blocks.text: When we start having kids, I don't want other people really raising my kids. But the thing is, I don't want to play basketball for 10 more years. I want to be done in the next five, six years. So during that time, I'm fine being home a lot. I'm a chill dude. I want to raise my kids.

quotes.speaker: Michael Porter Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Michael Porter Jr. on strict upbringing and early basketball focus
quotes.excerpt: They kept me so locked up. If I was texting girls and stuff, they were strict.
quotes.quote: They kept me so locked up. If I was texting girls and stuff, they were strict. If I wanted to go to the high school football game, my mom was like, 'Okay, I'm going to go with you.' They didn't let me do any of that. I grew up, I was always good at basketball, became the number one player in the world in high school. They kept me so locked up.

quotes.speaker: Michael Porter Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Michael Porter Jr. on having his phone taken away for a year
quotes.excerpt: One time I got my phone taken for a whole year.
quotes.quote: One time I got my phone taken for a whole year. I think I got my phone for the first time in seventh grade. They kept catching me texting girls and they would take it for a few days. I would get it back, they kept catching me. I think in the eighth grade, they took my phone for a year.

quotes.speaker: Michael Porter Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Michael Porter Jr. on parents monitoring his text messages via software
quotes.excerpt: They had downloaded some software on my phone that made it so all my texts were going
quotes.quote: They had downloaded some software on my phone that made it so all my texts were going and I didn't know, it was going to their computer. So that's why they saw it.

quotes.speaker: Michael Porter Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Michael Porter Jr. on waiting until college to lose his virginity
quotes.excerpt: I didn't lose my virginity until college actually.
quotes.quote: I didn't lose my virginity until college actually.

quotes.speaker: Michael Porter Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Michael Porter Jr. on not being intimidated by the college dating scene
quotes.excerpt: I wasn't, because the way we were raised, it wasn't like I couldn't, because I knew I could.
quotes.quote: I wasn't, because the way we were raised, it wasn't like I couldn't, because I knew I could, but I just didn't. And then some thought came around and got me.

quotes.speaker: Michael Porter Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Michael Porter Jr. on the difficulty of dating when a partner is not feeling it
quotes.excerpt: What about when you date a dude and then he isn't really feeling that?
quotes.quote: What about when you date a dude and then he isn't really feeling that?

quotes.speaker: Michael Porter Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Michael Porter Jr. on the strategic advantage of ending relationships on good terms
quotes.excerpt: If I end on a good note with a girl, it's going to be way harder for her
quotes.quote: If I end on a good note with a girl, it's going to be way harder for her to move on than if she hates me.

quotes.speaker: Michael Porter Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Michael Porter Jr. on upcoming podcast plans and professional production
quotes.excerpt: I kind of revamped it and made it super professional. I'm going to come out with 10 really
quotes.quote: I kind of revamped it and made it super professional. I'm going to come out with 10 really fire episodes in August and September. I'm about to make it like a whole thing. I'm trying to, I'm going to make it like a really big podcast.
